title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Código e Padrões: Escrever e manter código limpo, testável e bem documentado, especialmente nas custom actions do Rasa (Python) e nos scripts do BLiP (JavaScript/Node.js).

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the job


At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.



About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.

You’ll join a collaborative, empowered, and agile team responsible for enterprise data distribution applications and backend APIs that serve external customers worldwide, including international markets such as Canada and Japan . This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical DevOps operations, design scalable solutions, and continuously evolve our platform’s reliability, performance, and security.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript (not TypeScript).
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.

Com domínio em Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Keycloak, Azure AD, Auth0 e outras soluções de identidade, projeta fluxos de autenticação robustos e integrações seguras entre múltiplos sistemas internos e externos. Linguagem: Java 8–21

Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Apache Camel

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.


This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.  

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.


What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Judi is a U.S.-based healthcare technology company that provides pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services. Their focus is on making prescription drug pricing more transparent and affordable for employers, health plans, and patients.

Join our mission to transform our nation’s healthcare system as a Senior Full-stack Software Developer. In this role, you will assist in leading projects from design to delivery. Partner with product managers and designers to define requirements during discovery and planning. Collaborate with developers to deliver those requirements on time as new features or improvements to existing functionality.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • We have a remote-first culture.
  • You will make a tangible impact on society. Your code will directly improve healthcare experiences for millions.
  • We are a late-stage startup with stability. We have startup energy with a focus on delivery, but healthy processes with a strong financial outlook that provides a sense of security.


Position Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll combine technical leadership with hands-on coding to build scalable, high-impact healthcare technology. You will:

  • Exercise leadership over features from design to delivery.
  • Be a partner to product, design, and quality assurance team members.
  • Become a subject matter expert on your team’s products.
  • Provide technical support to cross-functional team members and stakeholders.

  • Work in an Agile/Scrum environment.

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and collaborative spirit:

  • 7+ years of job-related experience.
  • Desire to work at a health tech company.
  • Strong Python (Flask / SQLAlchemy) and React / Typescript experience.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL database knowledge (e.g., common table expressions, windowing functions, views, stored procedures, full-text or geospatial indexing).
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.
  • Git expertise and experience working in a mono repo.
  • Able to demonstrate agency, urgency, and ownership over delivering quality work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Pharmacy Benefits Manager (PBM) experience is a plus.


What You Get:

  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team;
  • Unlimited PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule;
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences;
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work.


This position description is designed to be flexible, allowing management the opportunity to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as needed to best meet organizational goals.

Bitget is one of the world’s leading digital assets ecosystems. With over 120 million registered users, Bitget has one of the most comprehensive suites of blockchain products and services available via bitget.com.


Our mission is to support the growth of the digital assets industry and we believe it represents the future of finance. What we do empowers the future of finance by ensuring secure, efficient and smart digital transactions.


We are one of the fastest growing companies in the digital asset sector. If you are looking for cutting-edge work, where you will have opportunities to develop your career among peers who are experts in their field, and you believe in the future of crypto currency, then look no further than Bitget!


What you'll do


  • Translate corporate documents into Brazilian Portuguese with accuracy and cultural relevance.
  • Proofread and edit content to ensure consistency, grammar, and style.
  • Apply internal glossaries and style guides for terminology consistency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align on context and objectives.
  • Manage multiple translation projects under tight deadlines.
  • Use CAT tools effectively to support translation workflow.
  • Safeguard sensitive and confidential information.
  • Participate in linguistic quality assurance reviews.
  • Stay current with industry language trends, especially in crypto.


What you'll need


  • Bachelor’s degree in Translation, Linguistics, or related field (or currently pursuing).
  • Proven translation experience, ideally in corporate or crypto-related settings.
  • Fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Solid understanding of grammar, syntax, and cultural nuances.
  • Proficiency in CAT tools.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • High professionalism in handling confidential content.


Why Bitget?


  • Bitget is the world's leading web 3 platform for copy trading and one of the world's largest and most respected exchanges
  • We are a global company with staff members from over 50 different countries and regions
  • We are growing and looking for world-class ambitious talents to help us continue this journey
  • We have a streamlined structure that empowers employees to work efficiently, delivering the best results in a short timeframe
  • We offer competitive salaries and benefits
  • Blockchain technology and digital assets have the potential to change finance in a way no other technology can - be part of it!



If you are ambitious and believe that digital assets could be the next financial and technological revolution, please apply!

title: Engenheiro de Planejamento
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um Engenheiro de Planejamento para atuar ONSHORE em um importante projeto do setor de fabricação e engenharia industrial, em uma empresa de referência no segmento de Óleo & Gás.


O profissional será responsável por desenvolver, controlar e reportar cronogramas executivos e integrados, assegurando a execução eficiente dos projetos em conformidade com prazos, custos e padrões de qualidade.



Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, atualizar e controlar cronogramas executivos e integrados (EPC), garantindo a aderência às metas e prazos do projeto;
  • Elaborar relatórios físico-financeiros, curvas S e análises de desvios, propondo ações corretivas quando necessário;

  • Implementar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados a produtividade, custo e prazo;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e de acompanhamento com cliente e demais stakeholders;
  • Garantir a aderência às normas de SMS, qualidade e compliance durante toda a execução dos projetos.



Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Civil ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência consolidada em planejamento de projetos industriais, preferencialmente em Óleo & Gás, com vivência em fabricação, EPC ou estaleiros (fabrication yards);
  • Domínio das ferramentas Primavera P6, MS Project, Excel avançado e Power BI;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de custos, análise de riscos e indicadores de performance;
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado, para interface com fornecedores e elaboração de relatórios técnicos.

title: Senior Player Support Specialist
description:
Bring It On is creating the next generation of skill games. We deliver games that people enjoy for many years while earning money by playing excellently! Skill is the most exciting category in the games industry that enjoys rapid growth and immense opportunities.


In our culture, everyone has maximum impact, which means you will get the autonomy you deserve and the trust you yearn for. ● Proficiency with CRM tools and experience documenting interactions.

● Strong empathy, with an ability to listen attentively and provide tailored solutions.

● Excellent time management skills and the ability to work flexible hours.

Perks

● Attractive salary that meets your expectations.

If you feel the above describes you perfectly - Apply now!

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

  • Liderar o time técnico, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia e arquitetura de software.

  • Conhecimento em APIs REST e arquitetura de microserviços.

  • Tiver experiência com serviços em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Já tiver trabalhado com arquitetura orientada a eventos e filas de mensagens (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack .Net
description:
Company Overview

SEW is the #1 Energy and Water Cloud Platform, providing cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions for Digital Customer Engagement, Field Workforce Engagement, and Smart AI/Machine Learning to the Energy and Utility sector. We empower utilities to enhance customer service, optimize operational efficiency, and maximize return on investments through the SEW platform applications leveraging mobile, AI, Machine Learning, and Cloud technologies.

Searching for your dream job? At SEW, we strive to help our employees find passion and purpose. Join us in changing the way the world uses energy and water and become part of our innovative and talented team!


Position Overview

We are looking for a Mid Level Full Stack .Net Developer with good experience with C# and Angular to join our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain robust web and mobile applications that integrate seamlessly with SEW’s platform. The ideal candidate will be passionate about building scalable and efficient software solutions and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Key Responsibilities

Application Development:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web and mobile applications using modern frameworks and technologies.
  • Build responsive front-end interfaces that deliver exceptional user experiences.
  • Develop efficient and secure back-end services and APIs.

Analysis and Reporting:

  • Perform thorough analysis of complex data and recommend actionable strategies.
  • Develop complex database queries in SQL/TSQL and NoSQL.
  • Translate client requirements to technical architectural specifications and communicate this to delivery teams and clients.

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other developers, to define and implement solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure high-quality software development.

System Optimization:

  • Optimize application performance to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues promptly.

Innovation and Best Practices:

  • Define data architecture requirements for cross-product integration within and across cloud-based platforms.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Advocate for and implement best practices in software development, including testing, security, and CI/CD processes.
  • Write test plans and test cases to ensure application integrity is maintained.


Education and Experience Requirements

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in software development and product deployment.
  • Hands-on experience with .Net Core, .Net Framework, Angular, Entity Framework, Git, Unit Tests and Pipelines.
  • Strong technical documentation skills.
  • Expertise in MySQL, Oracle, or MS SQL Server (SAP HANA is a plus).
  • Experience with cloud architecture, including AWS, Azure, and Google (SAP BTP is a plus).
  • Effectively translate data modeling and BI requirements into the design process.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent human relations and documentation skills.
  • Strong ability to interpret customer and market insights and conduct data analysis.
  • Fluent English is required; Spanish is a plus.


Why Join SEW?

  • Be part of a mission-driven organization creating impactful solutions for the energy and water sectors.
  • Collaborate with a talented and innovative team on cutting-edge projects.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
  • Work in a culture that values diversity, creativity, and collaboration.


SEW is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Junior maintenance engineer
description:
A Maintenance Engineer here at Shape works closely with a multidisciplinary Agile team to build cutting-edge advanced analytics solutions. These solutions will generate insights from our connected data, enabling the team to advance the data- driven decision-making capabilities of our enterprise. This role requires understanding of engineering, troubleshooting and monitoring of rotating equipment. You will work closely with Data Scientists and Product Owners to ensure business value and quality.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to develop advanced analytics solutions to Predictive Analysis for vibration, thermography, oil analysis, lubrication and other metrics.
  • Receive and filter Predictive Analysis Results to be discussed or shared to Reliabilitys Specialists Team, helping to coordinate and/or request forward future corrective actions on the equipment.
  • Ensure the operation reliability and its performance (gas turbines, steam turbines, gas compressors and pumps) by acting as technical referent to assist the analysis of the results, elaboration of proper root cause assessments and issuance of technical review and recommendation.
  • Give guidance and assistance with regards to turbo machinery offshore equipment maintenance issues and failures.
  • Foster close cooperation across data scientists and data engineers, encouraging cross-training and mutual support.
  • Value assurance: work with business process owners to validate model outputs, construct appropriate trainings, tune models and ensure value created from models.
  • Problem framing: participate in problem framing together with business owners, data scientists and other engineers for identified opportunities.

Requirements:

  • Education: complete degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Experience working in reliability and/or maintenance activities focused on condition-based monitoring.
  • Experience with Lean Six-Sigma or advanced analytics projects
  • Experience working with predictive technologies and digital projects.
  • Experience with rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines), including interpretation of characteristic and performance curves.
  • Advanced knowledge in data analysis, focusing on correlating equipment and process variables to identify anomalies and optimize performance (such as vibration analysis, lubrication, thermography, among others).
  • Knowledge and experience in reading and interpreting P&IDs (Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams) and PFDs (Process Flow Diagrams).
  • Strong collaborator with cross-functional teams from tech, design, and business.
  • To be available to work at our offices, at Rio de Janeiro, RJ or Sao Paulo, SP.
  • Advanced/Fluent English.

Differential:

  • Experience in Industry (Oil & Gas, Metals & Mining, Pulp & Paper)
  • CREA is desirable.
  • Additional training or courses in rotating equipment and data analysis.
  • Knowledge of Python. Data Science, Machine Learnig and Statistics.

Benefits:

  • PPR (Profit Sharing): Possibility of extra compensation based on the companys results, according to your performance.
  • Health and Dental Plan: To ensure your care and well-being!
  • Flexible Benefit: Receive an amount that can be used according to your needs, including food, transportation, education, culture, and health. You decide how to use it!
  • Flexible Hours: Work at the best time for you and have a better quality of life.
  • Massages and Manicure in the Office: So you can relax and feel good about yourself.
  • Mentorship Program: Access development opportunities with the help of experienced professionals.
  • Gympass: To keep your health in check and take care of your body.
  • Snacks in the Office: Because everyone loves a snack at work!
  • Inclusive Environment: We value diversity and always strive to create a space where everyone can be authentic, respected, and feel part of something bigger.
  • Day off in Your Birthday Month: A day off in your birthday month to celebrate in any way you prefer
  • Extended Maternity/Paternity Leave: So you can enjoy this important time with your family, with peace of mind that your professional life will remain well-supported.
  • Childcare Assistance: To support you with the care of your young children.
  • Continuous Individualized Development Support: We offer support for your professional growth, respecting your personal needs and goals.
  • Culture and Well-being: We create an environment that values mental health, work-life balance, and encourages connection with culture.

The benefits provided with this position are not deducted from your paycheck!

title: Servente
description:
Quem somos?

-  Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?

  • Habilidades e Qualidades Essenciais:
  • Disposição física: A função exige esforço físico constante, incluindo levantar e transportar materiais pesados, escavar e trabalhar em diferentes condições.
  • Organização: Manter o canteiro de obras limpo e organizado, assim como as ferramentas e materiais, é crucial para a segurança e eficiência do trabalho.
  • Capacidade de seguir instruções: O servente trabalha sob a supervisão de pedreiros, mestres de obras e outros profissionais, sendo fundamental que consiga seguir orientações de forma precisa.
  • Trabalho em equipe: A colaboração com os demais membros da equipe é essencial para o bom andamento da obra.
  • Responsabilidade e proatividade: Cumprir as tarefas designadas com seriedade e, quando possível, antecipar necessidades e auxiliar em outras atividades.

Dia a Dia:

  • Preparação de Materiais: Carregar, descarregar e transportar materiais de construção, como tijolos, cimento, areia, pedras, entre outros, para os locais designados na obra.
  • Auxílio na Preparação de Superfícies: Ajudar na preparação das superfícies de trabalho, incluindo a limpeza, raspagem, nivelamento e demolição quando necessário.
  • Assistência na Execução de Tarefas: Prestar auxílio aos pedreiros e outros profissionais da construção civil, fornecendo ferramentas, materiais e suporte durante a realização de atividades como alvenaria, assentamento de pisos e revestimentos, entre outras.
  • Manutenção da Ordem e Segurança: Zelar pela organização e limpeza do canteiro de obras, garantindo que os materiais estejam armazenados de forma segura e que os resíduos sejam descartados adequadamente. Além disso, cumprir rigorosamente as normas de segurança estabelecidas, utilizando os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) fornecidos.
  • Suporte na Operação de Equipamentos: Auxiliar na montagem, desmontagem e operação de equipamentos simples, como andaimes, escadas, betoneiras, entre outros, seguindo as instruções dos responsáveis pela obra.
  • Comunicação e Colaboração: Manter uma comunicação clara e eficaz com os colegas de trabalho e supervisores, reportando problemas, sugestões ou necessidades relacionadas às atividades desempenhadas.

Local de trabalho : Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar. Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro

Horário : 7h as 17h de segunda a quinta-feira | 7h as 16h na sexta-feira


Requisitos:

O que precisamos que você tenha:

  • 1º grau incompleto  
  • Habilidades Físicas: Boa condição física para suportar o trabalho exigente, incluindo o levantamento e transporte de materiais pesados, além da capacidade de permanecer em pé por longos períodos.
  • Conhecimento Básico: Familiaridade com as ferramentas, materiais e técnicas utilizadas na construção civil é desejável, mas não obrigatória, pois o treinamento pode ser fornecido no local de trabalho.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Capacidade de seguir instruções detalhadas e executar tarefas com precisão, garantindo a qualidade do trabalho realizado.

O que vamos amar se você tiver:

  • Atitude Proativa: Disposição para aprender e colaborar, demonstrando iniciativa para auxiliar sempre que necessário e contribuir para o bom andamento da obra.
  • Comprometimento com a Segurança: Consciência dos riscos envolvidos no trabalho em um canteiro de obras e compromisso em seguir rigorosamente as medidas de segurança estabelecidas para prevenir acidentes.

Benefícios

Benefícios

  • Mobilidade: Cartão Swile com VT (combo mobilidade) para você escolher a melhor forma de chegar ao trabalho.
  • Alimentação: VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar.
  • Saúde: Plano de saúde, programa Vittude de saúde mental, plano odontológico e Totalpass para cuidar do seu bem-estar físico e mental.
  • Finanças: Descontos diferenciados em folha de pagamento.

  • Convênio com SESC: Oferece acesso a diversas atividades de lazer e cultura, promovendo a qualidade de vida pra você e sua família.

title: Pedreiro
description:
Quem somos?

-  Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?

Um profissional experiente e dedicado para integrar nossa equipe como Pedreiro com Experiência em Obras Hospitalares. O profissional será fundamental na execução de serviços de alvenaria, revestimento, acabamento e outras atividades correlatas em nossos projetos de construção e reforma do Hospital Municipal Souza Aguiar, garantindo a qualidade e a segurança das instalações.

Dia a Dia:

  • Execução de alvenaria estrutural e de vedação, utilizando blocos de concreto, cerâmicos ou outros materiais.
  • Preparo e aplicação de argamassas para assentamento de revestimentos (pisos, azulejos, pastilhas, etc.).
  • Realização de revestimentos internos e externos, garantindo o nivelamento e o alinhamento adequados.
  • Construção de formas de madeira e armação para estruturas de concreto simples.
  • Execução de pequenos reparos e manutenções em alvenaria e revestimentos existentes.
  • Interpretação de projetos e plantas, seguindo as especificações técnicas.
  • Utilização correta de ferramentas e equipamentos de construção civil, zelando pela sua conservação e segurança.
  • Colaboração com os demais membros da equipe de obra (engenheiros, mestres de obra, outros pedreiros, etc.).
  • Garantia da organização e limpeza do local de trabalho.
  • Cumprimento das normas de segurança do trabalho.

Local de trabalho : Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar. Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro

Horário : 7h as 17h de segunda a quinta-feira | 7h as 16h na sexta-feira


Requisitos:

O que precisamos que você tenha:

  • Experiência comprovada como pedreiro.
  • Experiência específica em obras hospitalares (construção e reforma).
  • Habilidade em execução de alvenaria, revestimento e acabamento.
  • Conhecimento de diferentes tipos de materiais de construção e suas aplicações.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e seguir orientações.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e compromisso com a qualidade do serviço.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no local da obra.

O que vamos amar se você tiver:

  • Curso profissionalizante na área de construção civil.
  • Experiência com instalações prediais (hidráulica, elétrica) em nível de apoio.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de solucionar problemas.
  • Comprometimento com prazos e metas.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.

Benefícios

Benefícios

  • Mobilidade: Cartão Swile com VT (combo mobilidade) para você escolher a melhor forma de chegar ao trabalho.
  • Alimentação: VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar.
  • Saúde: Plano de saúde, programa Vittude de saúde mental, plano odontológico e Totalpass para cuidar do seu bem-estar físico e mental.
  • Finanças: Descontos diferenciados em folha de pagamento.
  • Day off no aniversário: Proporcionando um dia de descanso para comemorar seu aniversário.
  • Convênio com SESC: Oferece acesso a diversas atividades de lazer e cultura, promovendo a qualidade de vida pra você e sua família.
  • Seguro de vida: Garante a segurança financeira da sua família em caso de imprevistos, proporcionando tranquilidade e proteção.

title: Coordenador de produto
description:
Qualificações:

- Formação superior em Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.

- Experiência prévia em gestão de produtos ou áreas relacionadas no setor de varejo.

- Habilidade analítica e experiência com análise de dados

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e liderança.

- Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de produtos e plataformas de e-commerce é um diferencial.

- Excel avançado

Responsabilidades:

1. Gestão de Produtos:

  - Coordenar o desenvolvimento e a gestão do portfólio de produtos.

  - Coordenar o cronograma de desenvolvimento de produto

  - Analisar tendências de mercado e comportamento do consumidor para identificar oportunidades de novos produtos.


2. Planejamento e Execução:

  - Desenhar estratégia de produto com desenho de Roadmap mensal com todo planejamento de lançamento e/ou divulgação de peças em estoque

  - Monitorar o desempenho dos produtos e implementar ações corretivas quando necessário.

  - Gerenciar ciclo de produto: analisar semanalmente as vendas e tomar decisões de ativação, inativação e reposição do mix

  - Cumprir e acompanhar orçamento de compras

  - Garantir e acompanhar entrega de pedidos de produção com datas pré combinadas

  - Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de marketing e vendas para garantir a visibilidade e a divulgação adequada dos produtos.

  - Desenvolver e aplicar treinamentos de produtos para time de vendas


3. Análise de Mercado:

  - Realizar pesquisas de mercado para entender a concorrência e as necessidades dos clientes.

  - Realizar pesquisas de mercado para acompanhar e conhecer tecnologias para produção com melhores custos benefícios para o negócio.

  - Analisar relatórios de vendas e KPIs para avaliar o desempenho dos produtos e identificar áreas de melhoria.


4. Coordenação de Equipe:

  - Supervisionar e orientar a equipe de produtos, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo.

  - Facilitar treinamentos e capacitações para a equipe sobre novos produtos e estratégias de vendas.


5. Relacionamento com Fornecedores:

  - Manter um bom relacionamento com fornecedores e parceiros estratégicos.

  - Desenvolver fornecedores sempre que necessário ao negócio

  - Negociar condições comerciais e prazos de entrega para garantir a qualidade e a competitividade dos produtos.
